title: Hearing on rolling out free child care for 2-year-olds
summary: The Council's Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education will examine the city's new 2-K program, which offers free child care to two-year-olds starting with 2,000 seats in five school districts in fall 2026. Officials will be asked about provider contracting delays, payment issues, workforce shortages and how families are being informed, as the program is set to expand to 12,000 seats funded by $425 million in fiscal year 2028.
